verdict.rationale: PayPal has a few narrow, built-in event-driven automations that users can configure: automatic payment reminders on invoices [paypal-docs-50] and automated payment recovery for failed subscription payments [paypal-docs-40]. There is no documented general rules engine for defining custom event→action rules. Webhooks [paypal-docs-9] are only a developer building block for constructing such automation, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a user-definable rules/workflow engine with arbitrary event triggers and actions, conditions/logic, documentation of rule configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
